## F — Verify list, Chapter Seven continued, distracted driving, emotions, cell phones and electronic devices

Consolidated VERIFY index for the Chapter Seven continued, distracted driving, emotions, cell phones and electronic devices dossier. Open items: sec12-D01 (official exam facts unknown in the safe view; passing percentage and time limit not stated on the licensing pages), sec12-D02 (market-signal pack not researched; no competitive intelligence supplied). Every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 carries high confidence with one cited handbook page and no verify flag; no fact statement contains a withheld value. No external review request was raised because no rule in the section requires legal, clinical or safety review beyond the issuer's own text. Competitive teardown is a scoped disposition in E2, not a debt.
